    JME 2.0.0
    C library · PHP · Python · Dart · v2.0.0

    JPL Moshier Ephemeris

    One reference for the native JME C library and the three language bindings. Every binding calls the same jme_* functions and reads the same JME_* constants. Nothing is rounded, reshaped, or given a default the C function does not have.

    Start with Quick Start Browse API Reference
    225 functions 478 constants ISO C17

    What this page covers

    • C — build and link libjme .
    • PHP — FFI wrapper, prebuilt libraries, Laravel.
    • Python — ctypes package jmeph-ffi .
    • Dart — Flutter plugin for desktop and mobile.

    Same native contract

    Status codes, output arrays, and error buffers stay in the C layout on every language.

    Three calculation engines

    JPL kernels through CALCEPH, Moshier analytical theory, or VSOP87 + ELP2000 + Meeus.

    Matching native binaries

    Each language binding must load a library built from the matching C release. Rebuild it when the C sources change.

    Start

    Installation

    Install the language you call. The C library is the implementation. PHP, Python, and Dart load a shared library built from it.

    Install commands and entry points
    Language Install Entry
    C cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build #include "jme/jme.h"
    PHP composer require jayeshmepani/jpl-moshier-ephemeris-php new JmeEph\FFI\JmeEphFFI()
    Python pip install jmeph-ffi from jpl_moshier_ephemeris import JmeEph
    Dart dart pub add jpl_moshier_ephemeris_dart import 'package:jpl_moshier_ephemeris_dart/jpl_moshier_ephemeris_dart.dart';

    Start

    Quick Start

    Julian day of 2000-01-01 12:00 TT-scale input as UT for jme_calc_ut , then the Sun's geometric longitude. The six-value result array is the native layout on every language.

    Shared call jme_calc_ut(jd_ut, body, flags, results, error)

    The tabs below are this same call in each language. The argument order does not change.

    C

    #include "jme/jme.h"
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void) {
    double jd = jme_julian_day(2000, 1, 1, 12.0, JME_CALENDAR_GREGORIAN);
    double xx[6];
    char error[256];
    int result = jme_calc_ut(jd, JME_BODY_SUN, JME_CALC_TRUE_POSITION, xx, error);
    if (result == JME_OK) {
        printf("Sun longitude: %.10f\n", xx[0]);
        return 0;
    }
    printf("JME error: %s\n", error);
    return 1;
}

    PHP

    <?php
use FFI;
use JmeEph\FFI\JmeEphFFI;

$jme = new JmeEphFFI();
$jd = $jme->jme_julian_day(2000, 1, 1, 12.0, JmeEphFFI::JME_CALENDAR_GREGORIAN);
$xx = $jme->getFFI()->new('double[6]');
$error = $jme->getFFI()->new('char[256]');
$result = $jme->jme_calc_ut($jd, JmeEphFFI::JME_BODY_SUN, JmeEphFFI::JME_CALC_TRUE_POSITION, $xx, $error);

if ($result === JmeEphFFI::JME_OK) {
    echo "Sun longitude: {$xx[0]}\n";
} else {
    echo 'JME error: ' . FFI::string($error) . "\n";
}

    Python

    from jpl_moshier_ephemeris import (
    JME_BODY_SUN,
    JME_CALC_TRUE_POSITION,
    JME_CALENDAR_GREGORIAN,
    JME_OK,
    JmeEph,
    c_double,
    create_string_buffer,
)

jme = JmeEph()
jd = jme.jme_julian_day(2000, 1, 1, 12.0, JME_CALENDAR_GREGORIAN)
xx = (c_double * 6)()
err = create_string_buffer(256)
result = jme.jme_calc_ut(jd, JME_BODY_SUN, JME_CALC_TRUE_POSITION, xx, err)
print(xx[0] if result == JME_OK else err.value.decode())

    Dart

    import 'dart:ffi';

import 'package:ffi/ffi.dart';
import 'package:jpl_moshier_ephemeris_dart/jpl_moshier_ephemeris_dart.dart';

void main() {
  final jme = JmeEph();
  final jd = jme.bindings.jme_julian_day(2000, 1, 1, 12.0, JME_CALENDAR_GREGORIAN);
  using((arena) {
    final xx = arena<Double>(6);
    final err = arena<Char>(256);
    final result = jme.bindings.jme_calc_ut(
      jd,
      JME_BODY_SUN,
      JME_CALC_TRUE_POSITION,
      xx,
      err,
    );
    if (result == JME_OK) {
      print('Sun longitude: ${xx[0]}');
    } else {
      print('JME error: ${err.cast<Utf8>().toDartString()}');
    }
  });
}

    Start

    Engine Selection

    The C library chooses the backend. Bindings pass the same token through jme_set_astro_models . They do not reimplement the choice.

    Modes

    • JPL: CALCEPH and a readable .bsp kernel. No analytical fallback.
    • MOSHIER: analytical planets and Moon. No kernel file.
    • VSOP_ELP_MEEUS: VSOP87, ELP2000-82B, and Meeus.
    • ANALYTICAL: the analytical stack selected by that token.
    • AUTO: JPL first, then the analytical fallback.

    Unset token

    If the call is omitted, the library also reads JME_ENGINE with the same names: JPL , MOSHIER , VSOP_ELP_MEEUS , or ANALYTICAL .

    Shared call jme_set_astro_models(models, flags)

    The tabs below pass the same tokens. models is text such as ENGINE=JPL .

    C

    jme_set_astro_models("ENGINE=JPL", 0);
jme_set_astro_models("ENGINE=MOSHIER", 0);
jme_set_astro_models("ENGINE=VSOP_ELP_MEEUS", 0);
jme_set_astro_models("ENGINE=AUTO", 0);
jme_set_jpl_file("path/to/de440s.bsp");

    PHP

    $jme->jme_set_astro_models('ENGINE=JPL', 0);
$jme->jme_set_astro_models('ENGINE=MOSHIER', 0);
$jme->jme_set_astro_models('ENGINE=VSOP_ELP_MEEUS', 0);
$jme->jme_set_astro_models('ENGINE=ANALYTICAL', 0);
$jme->jme_set_astro_models('ENGINE=AUTO', 0);

    Python

    jme.jme_set_astro_models(b"ENGINE=JPL", 0)
jme.jme_set_astro_models(b"ENGINE=MOSHIER", 0)
jme.jme_set_astro_models(b"ENGINE=VSOP_ELP_MEEUS", 0)
jme.jme_set_astro_models(b"ENGINE=AUTO", 0)

    Dart

    final jme = JmeEph();
jme.configureEngine('JPL', jplFile: '/path/to/de440s.bsp');
jme.configureEngine('MOSHIER');
jme.configureEngine('VSOP_ELP_MEEUS');
jme.configureEngine('AUTO');

    Start

    Runtimes and Kernels

    This C release is 2.0.0. Each language binding must load a shared library built from the matching C release; rebuild it when the C sources change.

    Kernels are separate. Moshier and the other analytical modes do not need a .bsp file. Strict JPL mode does. Kernels are not inside the C repository or the language packages.

    Where the library comes from

    • C: cmake --build produces libjme.so , libjme.dylib , or jme.dll .
    • PHP: Composer installs a prebuilt archive from the prebuilt-libs release . Override with JME_LIBRARY_PATH .
    • Python: the jmeph-ffi wheel contains the same desktop libraries, plus CALCEPH. Override with JME_LIBRARY_PATH and JME_CALCEPH_LIBRARY_PATH .
    • Dart: Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows libraries ship inside the pub package. Desktop CALCEPH is 5.0.1. Android and iOS CALCEPH is 4.0.5.

    JPL kernels

    Download de440s.bsp , de440.bsp , or de441.bsp from the kernel release. de441.bsp is published in parts because the file exceeds GitHub's asset limit. Join the parts in order.

    • jpl-kernels release 
    jme_set_ephemeris_path("/path/to/ephe");
jme_set_jpl_file("/path/to/de440s.bsp");

    Desktop archive names

    Platform Archive JME library
    Linux x64 jme-linux-x64.tar.gz libjme.so
    Linux ARM64 jme-linux-arm64.tar.gz libjme.so
    macOS x64 jme-macos-x64.tar.gz libjme.dylib
    macOS ARM64 jme-macos-arm64.tar.gz libjme.dylib
    Windows x64 jme-windows-x64.zip jme.dll

    Language

    C

    ISO C17 ( __STDC_VERSION__ 201710L , the same language as ISO/IEC 9899:2018). CMake 3.21 or newer. JME_VERSION is 2.0.0 . JME_VERSION_ID stays 400 .

    Build

    cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-ffp-contract=off"
cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure

    Release builds keep -ffp-contract=off so the floating-point contraction matches the tested results. If CALCEPH is missing, the library still builds and JPL calls return an explicit error.

    Public surface

    • Headers: include/jme/jme.h and include/jme/jme_extended.h .
    • 225 public jme_* functions.
    • 478 public JME_* constants, plus the include guards JME_JME_H and JME_EXTENDED_H .
    • jme_calc_ut always fills six result slots, including the rates.

    Language

    PHP

    Package jayeshmepani/jpl-moshier-ephemeris-php . PHP 8.3 or newer, with ext-ffi . Class JmeEph\FFI\JmeEphFFI exposes each C function as a method of the same name.

    Enable FFI

    extension=ffi
ffi.enable=1

    Platform packages

    Ubuntu / Debian

    sudo apt install php8.3-ffi

# Or for PHP 8.4
sudo apt install php8.4-ffi

    RHEL / Fedora

    sudo dnf install php-ffi
# or
sudo yum install php-ffi

    macOS

    # Homebrew PHP already includes FFI
brew install php@8.3

    Windows

    PHP 8.3 and newer for Windows includes FFI. Enable it in php.ini as shown above.

    Verify FFI

    php -r "echo extension_loaded('ffi') ? 'FFI loaded' : 'FFI not loaded';"
php -r "echo ini_get('ffi.enable') ? 'FFI enabled' : 'FFI not enabled';"

    Point the loader at a library built from this release with JME_LIBRARY_PATH when the bundled file is not the one you want. Kernel files, when you use JPL, go through jme_set_ephemeris_path . 

    $jme = new JmeEph\FFI\JmeEphFFI();
$jme->jme_set_ephemeris_path(__DIR__ . '/ephe');

    Language

    PHP Laravel

    The PHP package includes a service provider and a facade. Laravel 11 discovers the provider. Older applications register it in config/app.php .

    Laravel before 11

    'providers' => [
    JmeEph\Service\JmeEphServiceProvider::class,
],
'aliases' => [
    'JmeEph' => JmeEph\Service\JmeEphFacade::class,
],

    Configuration

    'library_path' => env('JME_LIBRARY_PATH'),
'engine' => env('JME_ENGINE', 'AUTO'),
'ephemeris_path' => env('JME_EPHEMERIS_PATH'),

    Facade

    $jd = JmeEph::jme_julian_day(
    2000,
    1,
    1,
    12.0,
    JmeEph::JME_CALENDAR_GREGORIAN
);

    Language

    Python

    Package jmeph-ffi on PyPI, import name jpl_moshier_ephemeris . Python 3.10 or newer. Pure ctypes. No extension module. End users do not download a separate binary: the wheel contains libjme and CALCEPH for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

    Load order

    1. JME_LIBRARY_PATH and JME_CALCEPH_LIBRARY_PATH
    2. the libraries bundled in the wheel
    3. common system library paths

    String arguments that the C API takes as char * are passed as bytes, for example b"ENGINE=MOSHIER" . Output buffers are create_string_buffer . Numeric output arrays are c_double arrays.

    Language

    Dart

    Package jpl_moshier_ephemeris_dart . Dart 3.3 or newer and Flutter 3.19 or newer. JmeEph loads the library. JmeBindings is the direct jme_* surface. Constants such as JME_BODY_SUN are top-level Dart names.

    Platforms in the package

    • Android arm64-v8a and x86_64 , with libjme.so and libcalceph.so .
    • iOS Jme.xcframework and Calceph.xcframework , device and simulator.
    • Linux, macOS, and Windows desktop libraries beside the Flutter build.

    configureEngine writes ENGINE=... into jme_set_astro_models . For JPL it also opens the kernel and throws if that open fails. Allocate output pointers with arena from package:ffi . Do not free memory the C library still owns.

    Contract

    API Contract

    The counts below are the native header surface. PHP, Python, and Dart generate their declarations from those headers.

    Functions

    225 public jme_* functions

    Constants

    478 public JME_* constants
+ JME_JME_H
+ JME_EXTENDED_H
    • Names stay jme_* and JME_* in every language.
    • JME_OK is 0 . JME_ERR is -1 . The error buffer is caller-owned.
    • jme_calc_ut writes six doubles. Indexes 0–2 are position. Indexes 3–5 are the rates. The call fills the rates even when the caller does not request JME_CALC_SPEED .
    • The two include guards are not calculation constants. The bindings still export them because they export every JME_* macro.
