    JME_BODY_VESTA -1265 Body id for Vesta. Calculation support depends on the selected engine and, for JPL, the loaded kernel. Unsupported targets return JME_ERR.

    Constant group

    Calculation Flags

    Combine these bits in the flags argument of jme_calc, jme_calc_ut, and the calls that share that flags word. Pass 0 for the default place. jme_calc still fills the six result slots when JME_CALC_SPEED is absent.

    Constant Value Use
    JME_CALC_NONE 0 No extra bits. Pass this, or the number 0, when you want the default place. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_SPEED 1 Speed bit. jme_calc and jme_calc_ut still fill indexes 3–5, the rates, whether or not you set it. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_EQUATORIAL 2 Ask for equatorial coordinates instead of ecliptic coordinates. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_XYZ 4 Ask for a rectangular vector. Same bit value as JME_CALC_RECTANGULAR and JME_CALC_RAW_VECTOR. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_RADIANS 8 Return angles in radians instead of degrees. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_BARYCENTRIC 16 Use the solar-system barycentre as the origin. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_HELIOCENTRIC 32 Use the Sun as the origin. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_TRUE_POSITION 64 Ask for the true geometric place rather than the apparent place. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_J2000 128 Express the place in the J2000 frame. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_NO_NUTATION 256 Leave nutation out of this call. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_SIDEREAL 512 Subtract the active ayanamsa. Set the mode first with jme_set_sidereal_mode. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_APPARENT_POSITION 0 The apparent-place choice. Its value is 0, so it is the default when no true-position bit is set. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_ASTROMETRIC 3072 Astrometric place: light time and light deflection without aberration. It combines the no-aberration and no-deflection bits as this enum defines them. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_CENTER_BODY 4096 Take the centre from the call that has a centre argument, rather than from the default. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_DISTANCE_AU 0 Distance in astronomical units. Its value is 0, so it is the default distance unit. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_DISTANCE_KM 8192 Distance in kilometres. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_HIGH_PRECISION 16384 High-precision request bit. The published reduction does not drop series terms when this bit is absent. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_ICRS 32768 Express the place in the ICRS frame. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_NO_ABERRATION 1024 Leave aberration out of an apparent place. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_NO_LIGHT_DEFLECTION 2048 Leave gravitational light deflection out. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_RAW_VECTOR 4 Rectangular vector. Same value as JME_CALC_XYZ. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_RECTANGULAR 4 Rectangular coordinates. Same value as JME_CALC_XYZ. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_SPHERICAL 0 Spherical coordinates. Its value is 0, so it is the default shape. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_STRICT 65536 Fail instead of substituting another model or another centre. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_TOPOCENTRIC 131072 Compute for the observer stored by jme_set_topo. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_VELOCITY_PER_DAY 0 Rates per day. Its value is 0, so it is the default rate unit. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.
    JME_CALC_VELOCITY_PER_SECOND 262144 Rates per second. Combine it with other JME_CALC_* bits in flags.

    Constant group

    Calendar and Time Constants

    Pass these to calendar and time calls: which calendar, which time scale, and which Delta-T or tidal choice.

    Constant Value Use
    JME_SECONDS_PER_DAY 86400.0 Length of a day in seconds, 86400. Use it to turn a Julian-date fraction into seconds.
    JME_CALENDAR_JULIAN 0 Calendar-system selector.
    JME_CALENDAR_GREGORIAN 1 Calendar-system selector.
    JME_TIME_DELTAT_AUTOMATIC 389 Default Delta-T choice for jme_delta_t_ex: IERS values where the embedded table covers the date, the 2021 Stephenson revision before that table, and Espenak–Meeus 2006 after it.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_AUTOMATIC 390 Tidal choice that applies no extra historical correction. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when you do not want a DE-specific acceleration.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE200 391 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE200 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE403 392 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE403 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE404 393 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE404 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE405 394 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE405 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE406 395 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE406 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE421 396 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE421 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE430 397 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE430 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE431 398 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE431 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris.
    JME_TIME_TIDAL_DE441 399 Tidal acceleration associated with the DE441 planetary ephemeris. Pass this to jme_set_tid_acc when long-range Delta-T should follow that ephemeris. No historical tidal acceleration has been published for DE441, so pre-1955 Delta-T then returns a non-finite value and an error.

    Constant group

    Eclipse and Event Flags

    These name eclipse contacts and eclipse types. Use them to read a circumstance value or to recognise a returned type. They are not a replacement for the eclipse search calls.

    Constant Value Use
    JME_ECLIPSE_FIRST_CONTACT 295 First contact, the start of the partial phase. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_FOURTH_CONTACT 296 Fourth contact, the end of the partial phase. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_LUNAR_PARTIAL 297 Lunar eclipse type: partial. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_LUNAR_PENUMBRAL 298 Lunar eclipse type: penumbral. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_LUNAR_TOTAL 299 Lunar eclipse type: total. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_MAX_VISIBLE 300 Maximum eclipse at the place you asked about. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_PENUMBRAL_BEGIN 301 Start of the penumbral phase of a lunar eclipse. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_PENUMBRAL_END 302 End of the penumbral phase of a lunar eclipse. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_SECOND_CONTACT 303 Second contact, the start of totality or annularity. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_SOLAR_ANNULAR 304 Solar eclipse type: annular. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_SOLAR_CENTRAL 305 The axis of the shadow meets the Earth. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_SOLAR_HYBRID 306 Solar eclipse type: hybrid, annular on part of the path and total on part. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_SOLAR_NONCENTRAL 307 The eclipse is not central. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_SOLAR_PARTIAL 308 Solar eclipse type: partial. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_SOLAR_TOTAL 309 Solar eclipse type: total. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_THIRD_CONTACT 310 Third contact, the end of totality or annularity. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.
    JME_ECLIPSE_VISIBLE 311 The eclipse is visible for the circumstance you tested. Read it against the attributes returned by the eclipse calls.

    JME_HOUSE_APC 313 APC houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_AZIMUTHAL 314 Azimuthal or horizontal-azimuth houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_CAMPANUS 315 Campanus houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.

    JME_HOUSE_GAUQUELIN 317 Gauquelin sector id. Do not pass it to jme_houses. Call jme_houses_gauquelin, which returns 36 sectors.
    JME_HOUSE_HORIZONTAL 318 Horizontal houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_KOCH 319 Koch houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_KRUSINSKI 320 Krusinski houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_MERIDIAN 321 Meridian houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_MORINUS 322 Morinus houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_PLACIDUS 323 Placidus houses. This is the usual time-based system. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_POLICH_PAGE 324 Polich-Page, or topocentric, houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_PORPHYRIUS 325 Porphyry houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.
    JME_HOUSE_REGIOMONTANUS 326 Regiomontanus houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.

    JME_HOUSE_VEHLOW_EQUAL 328 Vehlow equal houses. Pass it as house_system to jme_houses, jme_houses_ex, or jme_houses_ex2.

    Constant group

    Models and Frames

    Pass these to the model getters and to jme_set_astro_models when you need a named precession, nutation, obliquity, bias, or Delta-T series.

    Constant Value Use
    JME_VECTOR_AU_PER_DAY 0 State unit: astronomical units and days. Pass this as unit to a kernel position call or to jme_state_convert_units. It is the usual default.
    JME_VECTOR_KM_PER_DAY 1 State unit: kilometres and days.
    JME_VECTOR_AU_PER_SECOND 2 State unit: astronomical units and seconds.
    JME_VECTOR_KM_PER_SECOND 3 State unit: kilometres and seconds.
    JME_ORIENTATION_RAD_PER_DAY 0 Orientation unit: radians and days. Pass this as unit to a kernel orientation or angular-momentum call.
    JME_ORIENTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND 1 Orientation unit: radians and seconds.
    JME_MODEL_BIAS_IAU2000 330 IAU 2000 frame bias.
    JME_MODEL_BIAS_IAU2006 331 IAU 2006 frame bias.
    JME_MODEL_BIAS_NONE 332 No frame bias. Pass this when a matrix call should skip the bias rotation.
    JME_MODEL_NUT_IAU_1980 333 Nutation series IAU 1980. Pass this to jme_get_nutation or as the nutation token.
    JME_MODEL_NUT_IAU_2000A 334 Nutation series IAU 2000A.
    JME_MODEL_NUT_IAU_2000B 335 Nutation series IAU 2000B, the shorter 2000 series.
    JME_MODEL_OBL_IAU_1980 336 Obliquity polynomial IAU 1980. Pass this to jme_get_obliquity.
    JME_MODEL_OBL_IAU_2000 337 Obliquity polynomial IAU 2000.
    JME_MODEL_OBL_IAU_2006 338 Obliquity polynomial IAU 2006.
    JME_MODEL_PREC_IAU_1976 339 Precession IAU 1976. Pass this to jme_get_precession_matrix or as a precession token.
    JME_MODEL_PREC_IAU_2000 340 Precession IAU 2000.
    JME_MODEL_PREC_IAU_2006 341 Precession IAU 2006.
    JME_MODEL_PREC_LASKAR_1986 342 Precession Laskar 1986. From 1.1.0 this returns a matrix from Laskar's tables instead of an error.
    JME_MODEL_PREC_VONDRAK_2011 343 Precession Vondrák 2011, for long time spans.
    JME_MODEL_SIDT_IAU_1976 344 Sidereal-time model IAU 1976.
    JME_MODEL_SIDT_IAU_2006 345 Sidereal-time model IAU 2006.
    JME_MODEL_DELTAT_STEPHENSON_MORRISON_1984 346 Delta-T id for Stephenson and Morrison 1984. The source table is not in this library, so a request returns a non-finite value and an error.
    JME_MODEL_DELTAT_STEPHENSON_1997 347 Delta-T id for Stephenson 1997. The source table is not in this library, so a request returns a non-finite value and an error.
    JME_MODEL_DELTAT_STEPHENSON_MORRISON_2004 348 Delta-T id for Stephenson and Morrison 2004. The primary table is not transcribed here, so a request returns a non-finite value and an error. The separate linear-table id is the one that evaluates.
    JME_MODEL_DELTAT_ESPENAK_MEEUS_2006 349 Delta-T series of Espenak and Meeus 2006. Pass this to jme_delta_t_ex. Automatic mode uses it after the IERS table ends.
    JME_MODEL_DELTAT_STEPHENSON_ETC_2016 350 Delta-T from the published 2016 Table S15. Pass this to jme_delta_t_ex when you want that series rather than the 2021 revision used by automatic mode.
    JME_MODEL_REVISED_IAU_2000 401 Enum id for the revised IAU 2000 convention. Pass it only to a setter or getter that lists this id. It is not a position by itself.
    JME_MODEL_REVISED_IAU_2006 402 Enum id for the revised IAU 2006 convention. Pass it only where that id is documented.
    JME_MODEL_REVISED_PREC_LASKAR 403 Enum id naming a revised Laskar precession. Pass it only where that id is documented.
    JME_MODEL_REVISED_PREC_VONDRAK 404 Enum id naming a revised Vondrák precession. Pass it only where that id is documented.
    JME_MODEL_REVISED_PREC_LIESKE 405 Enum id naming a revised Lieske precession. Pass it only where that id is documented.

    Rise and Transit Flags

    Pass one of these as rsmi to jme_rise_trans or jme_rise_trans_true_hor. Rise, set, transit, and the twilights are different searches.

    Constant Value Use
    JME_RISE_ANTI_MERIDIAN_TRANSIT 8 Search for the transit across the anti-meridian, the lower culmination.
    JME_RISE_ASTRONOMICAL_TWILIGHT 512 Sun at the astronomical twilight depression.
    JME_RISE_CIVIL_TWILIGHT 128 Sun at the civil twilight depression.
    JME_RISE_DISC_BOTTOM 2048 Lower-limb horizon. Unsupported: jme_rise_trans returns JME_ERR when this bit is set.
    JME_RISE_DISC_CENTER 256 Use the centre of the disc rather than the upper limb.
    JME_RISE_FIXED_DISC_SIZE 1024 Keep the fixed horizon used by this engine (accepted).
    JME_RISE_HINDU_RISING 4096 Hindu rising convention. Unsupported: jme_rise_trans returns JME_ERR when this bit is set.
    JME_RISE_MERIDIAN_TRANSIT 4 Search for the transit across the meridian, the culmination.
    JME_RISE_NAUTICAL_TWILIGHT 64 Sun at the nautical twilight depression.
    JME_RISE_NO_REFRACTION 8192 Do not apply atmospheric refraction to the horizon.
    JME_RISE_RISE 1 Search for rising. Pass this as rsmi when you want the moment the body comes up.
    JME_RISE_SET 2 Search for setting.

    Constant group

    Status and Metadata

    JME_OK and JME_ERR are the status codes. The version and physical constants are for display and for your own unit conversions.

    Constant Value Use
    JME_JME_H 1 Header include guard exported by the bindings. Not a calculation constant.
    JME_VERSION 2.0.0 Version string of this library. jme_version copies it. This release is 2.0.0.
    JME_AU_KM 149597870.7 Astronomical unit in kilometres, 149597870.700. Use it when you convert a distance yourself. Light-time inside the library already uses this value.
    JME_SPEED_OF_LIGHT_KM_PER_SEC 299792.458 Speed of light in kilometres per second. Use it for your own light-time check. The library's reduction already uses the defined SI value.
    JME_OK 0 Native success/error status code.
    JME_ERR -1 Native success/error status code.
    JME_EXTENDED_H 1 Header include guard exported by the bindings. Not a calculation constant.
    JME_VERSION_ID 400 Numeric id 400. It stays 400 across this release. It is not the package version. Read JME_VERSION or call jme_version for the version string.

    Constant group

    Added in 1.1.0

    Constants that entered in 1.1.0. They belong to time scales, ayanamsa flags, the planet-centre policy, and the engine report.

    Constant Value Use
    JME_TIME_SCALE_UTC 0 Time scale for jme_time_scale_convert (ABI value).
    JME_TIME_SCALE_UT1 1 Time scale for jme_time_scale_convert (realised with the context Delta-T model).
    JME_TIME_SCALE_TAI 2 Time scale for jme_time_scale_convert.
    JME_TIME_SCALE_TT 3 Time scale for jme_time_scale_convert.
    JME_TIME_SCALE_TDB 4 Time scale for jme_time_scale_convert.
    JME_TIME_SCALE_TCG 5 Time scale for jme_time_scale_convert.
    JME_TIME_SCALE_TCB 6 Time scale for jme_time_scale_convert.
    JME_AYANAMSA_MEAN 0 jme_get_ayanamsa_ex2 flag: mean equinox of date.
    JME_AYANAMSA_TRUE 1 jme_get_ayanamsa_ex2 flag: true equinox of date (mean + nutation in longitude).
    JME_JPL_CENTER_STRICT 0 JPL planet-centre policy: missing planet centre is an error (default).
    JME_JPL_CENTER_BARYCENTER 1 JPL planet-centre policy: use the system barycentre when the planet centre is missing (opt-in).
    JME_ENGINE_ID_JPL 1 Engine reported by jme_calc_resolve_engine: JPL/CALCEPH.
    JME_ENGINE_ID_MOSHIER 2 Engine reported by jme_calc_resolve_engine: Moshier.
    JME_ENGINE_ID_VSOP87_ELP82B 3 Engine reported by jme_calc_resolve_engine: VSOP87A + ELP 2000-82B.
    JME_MODEL_NUT_IAU_2006A 351 Nutation model: IAU 2000A with IAU 2006 (P03) adjustments (ERFA eraNut06a).
    JME_SIDEREAL_LAHIRI_ICRC 406 Sidereal mode: Lahiri (ICRC definition).
    JME_MODEL_DELTAT_STEPHENSON_ETC_2021 407 Delta-T model: Morrison, Stephenson, Hohenkerk & Zawilski 2021 (Table S15, 2020 revision); used by AUTOMATIC before the IERS table.
    JME_MODEL_DELTAT_MS2004_TABLE1_LINEAR 408 Delta-T model: Morrison & Stephenson 2004 Table 1 with the authors' simple (linear) interpolation; their parabola -20 + 32t^2 outside the table.

    Check

    Quality

    Run the check in the repository you changed. The wrapper checks compare the generated surface with the C headers.

    C

    make test
make quality

    PHP

    composer verify:surface
composer quality

    Python

    python -m ruff check .
python -m ruff format . --check
python -m pyright
python -m pytest

    Dart

    ./scripts/quality.sh
